data.one_liner: Flutter UI kit for AI chat applications with streaming markdown, LaTeX, and tool calls.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable chat interface designed for LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Features built-in word-by-word streaming responses, markdown and syntax highlighting, LaTeX rendering, rich inline widgets, and RTL layout support.
use_when: Building an AI chat or assistant application in Flutter
Needing out-of-the-box word-by-word text streaming and markdown code block rendering
Integrating AI function-calling or human-in-the-loop action surfaces
avoid_when: Building a general-purpose peer-to-peer messaging app with no AI features
Needing an ultra-lightweight text component without a full chat interface
strengths: Built-in word-by-word streaming animation for AI responses
Enhanced markdown and syntax highlighting without extra dependencies
RTL language support out of the box
Rich inline widget rendering and AI action/tool-use surfaces
weaknesses: Tightly scoped to AI chat use cases rather than general messaging
Requires managing your own model backend connection

alternatives.name: flutter_chat_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this instead if you are building general-purpose, peer-to-peer chat without AI-specific features.
